epqs: USGS EPQS v1 (3DEP 1 m), queried 18 Nov 2026
verdict: Not a datum conflict (C numbers, S interpretation). With z increasing southward (corr 0.51 vs -0.40 for northward), the median of EPQS minus (617 + DSM) over 140 points at 30 m spacing is +0.03 m, so 617 m is the right reference for the DSM. Ground across the 400 x 300 m tile spans 619.8 to 632.9 m in EPQS (13.1 m), so 627.175 m is one point on the slope; the 10 m difference came from comparing a point with a tile reference. Caveats: the tile centre (37.2284, -80.4234) is an assumption (S), the correlation is only 0.51, and the DSM includes buildings and trees where EPQS is bare earth (min difference -24.2 m).
